Title: SpaceX working through Starship Flight 15 and 16 milestones
Author: Chris Bergin and Arran Reid
Date: October 18, 2026
Outlet: NASASpaceFlight.com
URL: https://www.nasaspaceflight.com/2026/10/spacex-flight-15-16-milestones/

Flight 16

Current activity points to Booster 23 and Ship 43 as the likely vehicles for Flight 16. Both are well into preparations.

Ship 43 is currently inside Mega Bay 2 and was seen welcoming Ship 40 back to Starbase after its return from an ocean landing half a world away. The view showed Ship 40 entering the facility to be greeted by three Ships in total: Ships 42, 43, and 44.

Booster 23 has already begun pre-launch testing with a trip to Massey’s for cryoproofing.

The testing concluded over the weekend with a Sunday morning trip back to Mega Bay 1 for engine installation.
